title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Auditorium on 1973-02-17
lineage: (*)SBD > MR > PCM > DAT > CDA > WAV > DAW(Bertha) > Audio DVD > DVD Audio Extractor v.3.3.2 (audio files extracted prior to burning to DVD disc) > 24/48 wav > downsampled to 44.1 wav with Wave Lab v.5.00a > dithered from 24 to 16 bit depth with Wave Lab UV22 HR Plugin > SBEs fixed with shntool v.2.0.3 (by set) > FLAC encoding with FLAC Frontend v.1.7.1 Etree Edition, FLAC v.1.1.2 (level 8)
source: Bertha Remaster of multi-signature source (shn id 32580)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the 2/17/73 Wall of Sound show, highlighted by a blistering Here Comes Sunshine → China Cat Sunflower → Rider sequence and crystal‑clear mix despite occasional tape glitches.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised – from Jerry’s soaring Strat work to Phil’s thunderous bass and Donna’s powerful vocals – with the second‑set HC Sunshine > China Cat > Rider standing out as a pinnacle of ’73 energy.  The Ashley remaster delivers outstanding separation, balance and clarity, though reviewers note a few tape cuts and PA quirks that give the recording a vintage, slightly imperfect feel.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 4–5) and enthusiastic comments about both musical performance and sound quality; minor technical glitches noted but do not detract from overall excellence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, well‑balanced mix with great instrument separation; some reviewers mention tape end abruptness, PA anomalies and occasional cuts, but overall the capture is praised as outstanding.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds strong momentum with tight jams and early classics; the second set flows into a legendary HC Sunshine > China Cat > Rider sequence before ending abruptly due to tape loss, leaving listeners wanting more.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as having an exponential, metallic Strat tone that fills the mix, especially during the HC‑Sunshine/China Cat/Rider stretch.
band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for leading with thunderous bass and delivering a strong Phil/Donna “box” throughout the show.
